items: How long is NDT training?

Two clocks run. Classroom hours: SNT-TC-1A recommends, per method, these hours for Level I and then Level II: {hoursList}. Atlantis's five-method packages (VT, PT, MT, UT and RT) follow those figures: {pkg.0} hours for Level I and {pkg.1} hours for Level II. Because theory is self-paced, the calendar time depends on how much you study each week. Experience hours set the real pace: for UT, SNT-TC-1A recommends {o.UT.0} hours of experience in the method for Level I and a further {o.UT.1} for Level II, logged on paid work under supervision, and your employer's written practice sets the binding numbers. See how long NDT training takes.
How much does NDT training cost?

It depends on your country: Register & Buy Now on the Atlantis portal shows the course fee for where you are. Published fee tables are on the country pages for the United States, the Middle East, Europe and South East Asia; on-site and corporate programmes are quoted. ASNT's own examination fees are separate; see NDT certification cost.
Is the training live or self-paced?

Primarily self-paced. You work through the online theory at your own pace, with an ASNT NDT Level III answering your questions, and portal access opens the moment you enrol. You practise in the Practical NDT simulator, then an ASNT Level III supervises the hands-on practical at your employer's facility. See online NDT training.
What NDT certification levels do you offer?
Level I and Level II training and examinations to ASNT SNT-TC-1A, certified by your employer under its written practice, and ASNT Level III exam preparation.
Is Atlantis training accepted by Aramco or ADNOC contractors?

Acceptance is always the operator's and employer's decision. Atlantis Academy trains to ASNT SNT-TC-1A, the scheme Aramco's SAEP-1112 references and most ADNOC contractors specify; the employer certifies under its written practice. ISO 9712 and PCN are examined by their own accredited bodies, which Atlantis does not administer.
Do you provide hands-on practical training?

Yes. Practical training runs on real specimens at your employer's facility: for on-site courses the instructor brings reference specimens and calibration blocks and trains on your own equipment. Between sessions you can practise in the Practical NDT simulator, which is practice only and not a substitute for the practical examination. The practical examination is administered by an ASNT Level III under your employer's written practice.
What happens if a candidate fails?
The employer's written practice sets the re-examination rule, typically a waiting period and a re-sit of the failed part after the Level III reviews the weak topics.
Do you offer corporate or on-site training?

Yes. On-site courses run at your facility for company crews, with practical sessions on your own equipment and ASNT Level III oversight. See corporate NDT training; on-site programmes are quoted, and we reply within one business day.
Are courses available in India?
Yes. Theory is self-paced online, and on-site courses run at your facility in India; Atlantis has an office in Hyderabad. See NDT training in Hyderabad.
Do you run bridging exams between ASNT and PCN or ISO 9712?

Atlantis doesn't administer PCN or ISO 9712 exams; those run through BINDT or an ISO 9712 accredited body. Atlantis Academy maps the overlapping body of knowledge, which minimises re-take effort. See the ASNT vs PCN comparison.
Do you offer NDT Level 2 recertification or renewal training?

Yes. A dedicated NDT Level 2 recertification and renewal course for inspectors approaching their 5-year SNT-TC-1A or CP-189 cycle covers technique refreshers, current code editions and vision-test documentation ahead of the renewal exam. It is available as an online refresher or bundled into a corporate NDT technician training contract for inspection company staff.
